implemented_R33_record_schema_observatio.clause_width_cap: <= V for canonical clauses over V variables

proof_obligations: Every serialized integer/string/list field in every R33 rule record is covered by the fixed-schema byte bound.
For BVE, positive+negative clauses are <= C total and resolvents are <= removed <= C, each clause width <= V.
For PURE, removed_clauses contains <= C clauses of width <= V.
Other rule records contain O(V) or O(1) literal/count payload.
Across the micro scheduler, the number of successful R33 records is <= the strict CLV state-triplet bound S.
Observed total R33_certificate_bytes must never exceed Bcert.
failure_conditions: Any concrete R33 record schema violates the symbolic payload assumptions.
